status_values.cited: stated in the method paper, docs or code at the given line
status_values.inferred_from_code: follows from the cited code, not stated in words
status_values.约定: 约定，未经推演: not found in the method sources; basis given

canonical_frame: project motion.npz: right-handed Z-up, metres; native Y-up maps (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y) (utils/motiogen/motion.py:17-18,55-61, applied in utils/motiogen/adapters.py:80-81)
paths: baselines/... are relative to the data root (config/baselines.json data_root); other paths are repository paths

up_axis.basis: baselines/chois_release/manip/lafan1/utils.py:462-463 "The floor is on z = xxx"; evaluation_metrics.py:63-64 "z is up"

forward_axis.basis: baselines/chois_release/manip/lafan1/utils.py:462-477: the rest-pose body-left axis (x) is projected to the xy plane and aligned to world +X, so the first frame faces -Y

fps.basis: baselines/chois_release/evaluation_metrics.py:44 determine_floor_height_and_contacts(..., fps=30); window 120 frames (trainer_chois.py:3122); no fps statement in the README

floor.definition: OMOMO world floor z = 0 (mesh sole on z = 0 in the source windows); CHOIS canonicalisation rotates about z and zeroes the first-frame root xy only; guidance=1 pulls the support toe to z = 0.02 m

objects.object_mass_source: not provided by the dataset (checked 2026-11-09: rest_object_geo json holds centre of mass and rest pose only; the OMOMO sequences hold pose / scale / centre of mass only; no mass in the OMOMO paper or the CHOIS code)
objects.main_analysis: hand-held object not modelled (loads are lower bounds)
